maria (Finance): Hey FYI found a weird line on the March invoice — 'Accelerator usage - rate change' appears three times for the same instance-hours. Can someone sanity-check?
ryan (Infra Ops): Huh, can you paste the raw line items?
maria (Finance): Sure, here's the snippet from the billing export (line ids redacted):
```
line_id: 4621, resource: nvidia-a100-40gb, region: us-west1, hours: 72, unit_price: 9.00, amount: 648.00
line_id: 4622, resource: nvidia-a100-40gb, region: us-west1, hours: 72, unit_price: 9.00, amount: 648.00
line_id: 4623, resource: nvidia-a100-40gb, region: europe-west4, hours: 72, unit_price: 2.50, amount: 180.00
discount_tag: COMMIT-2025 not applied on 4623
```
alex (SRE): Two identical us-west1 lines with same hours and price — that smells like a duplicate export + on-demand + reserved billing overlap. Did we recently migrate reservations?
ryan (Infra Ops): We moved some reserved pools last week and created new regional reservations as part of the gpu-provisioning change. Possible the older reservations didn't get terminated before the new ones became active.
zoe (Cloud Billing): Maria — I pulled the invoice feed. The double us-west1 lines are actually coming from two different SKU ids: SKU-A (on-demand) and SKU-R (reservation amortized). Normally reservation amortization shows as a credit line. Here the credit isn't present.
billing-bot: Detected anomaly: potential missing reservation credit for invoice 2026-03. Flagged 2 matching on-demand lines with reservation overlap. See internal ticket BILL-7642. :rotating_light:
maria (Finance): Missing credit + duplicate charge = net overcharge of $648. Any quick mitigation so we can correct before closing month?
zoe (Cloud Billing): I'll open a GC case but need confirmation of the reservation IDs that should have applied. Ryan, can you run this BigQuery check on our billing export and send reservation_id + timeline?
ryan (Infra Ops): Running now. Query I used:
```sql
SELECT invoice_month, resource_name, region, SUM(hours) as hrs, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT reservation_id) as reservations
FROM `company-billing.gcp.line_items`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND resource_name LIKE '%nvidia-a100%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, resource_name, region;
```
ryan (Infra Ops): Result: us-west1 shows reservation_ids [res-324, res-999]. res-999 is the new pool created 2026-03-10; res-324 was supposed to be decommissioned 2026-03-09 but shows active until 2026-03-15 in our provisioning logs.
alex (SRE): That mismatch window (10–15) explains overlap. Looks like deprovision job didn't remove res-324. I see a failed run in the orchestration job logs: `job/gpu-decomm-res-324` failed due to transient API 503.
zoe (Cloud Billing): Okay. That aligns. If a reservation remained active on the provider side, it should have generated a credit; the absence suggests either a processing delay or the credit was suppressed. I'll escalate with provider support and ask for provisional adjustment.
maria (Finance): What's our estimated exposure? If provider gives credit we fix it, otherwise we need an internal accrual/credit.
zoe (Cloud Billing): Exposure = duplicated on-demand line minus reservation credit. For us-west1 duplicated charge = $648. Reservation amortization expected ~ $-540 (estimate based on commit pricing). Net potential overcharge ~ $108 for that pair. But there are other smaller SKUs with similar overlap; total preliminary is ~$1.2k.
ryan (Infra Ops): I'll add a guard to the decomm job to verify reservation state before proceeding and a retry loop on 503. Also adding a post-decomm audit query to the runbook.
alex (SRE): I'll create a short alert that diffs invoice exported SKU counts vs active reservation sets weekly so we catch future mismatches.
zoe (Cloud Billing): I've opened the support ticket and requested provisional credit. Ticket: GCP-7891023. Linking docs and migration timeline.
maria (Finance): Thanks. Can we also annotate the invoice lines in our internal ledger so accounting doesn't pay the disputed amount until resolved?
zoe (Cloud Billing): Yep — I'll flag the lines and create a hold note in the accounting tracker.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-7642 and linked vendor case GCP-7891023. Next update ETA 24h.
maria (Finance): Great — keep updates here. Thanks everyone :pray:
